mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: The International Space Station serves as an unprecedented laboratory for scientific research and technological development in microgravity. It enables long-term human presence in space and serves as a stepping stone for future exploration missions to the Moon and Mars.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To maintain a continuous human presence in space for peaceful purposes, foster international cooperation, advance scientific knowledge, and inspire the next generation of explorers, scientists, and engineers worldwide.

mercury.name: MERCURY
mercury.desc: The smallest planet in our solar system and closest to the Sun—is only slightly larger than Earth's Moon.
mercury.fact: A day on Mercury lasts 59 Earth days, but a year is only 88 days!

venus.name: VENUS
venus.desc: Spinning in the opposite direction to most planets, Venus is the hottest world in our solar system.
venus.fact: Its atmosphere is so thick that the Sun looks like a smear of light from the surface.

earth.name: EARTH
earth.desc: Our home planet is the only place we know of so far that’s inhabited by living things.
earth.fact: Earth is the only planet not named after a god.

mars.name: MARS
mars.desc: The Red Planet is a dusty, cold, desert world with a very thin atmosphere.
mars.fact: Mars is home to Olympus Mons, the largest volcano in the entire solar system.

jupiter.name: JUPITER
jupiter.desc: Jupiter is more than twice as massive as the other planets of our solar system combined.
jupiter.fact: The Great Red Spot is a giant storm that has been raging for over 300 years.

saturn.name: SATURN
saturn.desc: Adorned with a dazzling system of icy rings, Saturn is unique in our solar system.
saturn.fact: Saturn is so light that it would float if you put it in a giant bathtub of water.

uranus.name: URANUS
uranus.desc: Uranus is an ice giant. It gets its blue-green color from methane gas in the atmosphere.
uranus.fact: It rotates on its side at nearly a 90-degree angle, like a rolling ball.

neptune.name: NEPTUNE
neptune.desc: Dark, cold, and whipped by supersonic winds, Neptune is the last of the hydrogen and helium gas giants.
neptune.fact: Neptune was the first planet located through mathematical calculations rather than a telescope.
